logistic-models-curve.alt: Left: the population P against time t for dP/dt = 0.0008P(1000 − P) with P(0) = 100. It rises slowly, then steeply, then levels off below the dashed carrying capacity line P = 1000, and is steepest where it crosses P = 500, near t = 2.75, where its concavity changes from up to down. Right: the rate dP/dt against P, a downward parabola that is 0 at P = 0 and P = 1000, with its largest value 200 at P = 500.
